summary.headline: Apple School Manager enrollment prerequisites reorganized
summary.summary: The guide restructures Apple School Manager enrollment prerequisites, including supported Apple mobile platforms and portal-based setup.
summary.adminImpact: Review the reorganized platform and tenant prerequisites before enabling School Manager enrollment.

summary.headline: Account-driven Apple enrollment requirements reorganized
summary.summary: The guide explicitly identifies iOS/iPadOS 15+ support; devices on 14.9 and earlier use Company Portal user enrollment.
summary.adminImpact: Target account-driven enrollment to iOS/iPadOS 15+ and plan the Company Portal path for older devices.

summary.headline: visionOS ADE prerequisites reorganized
summary.summary: The Vision Pro ADE guide separates device eligibility from Apple Business/School Manager portal, token, and Intune push-certificate requirements.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm devices are new or wiped and required Apple enrollment credentials are current before creating policies.

summary.headline: Userless Apple enrollment requirements reorganized
summary.summary: The userless corporate Apple enrollment guide now presents platform support and setup prerequisites in requirement sections.
summary.adminImpact: Use the reorganized prerequisites when validating userless iOS/iPadOS enrollment.

summary.headline: Direct macOS enrollment requirements reorganized
summary.summary: The direct macOS enrollment guide explicitly identifies macOS support and retains the requirement to unenroll a Mac from another MDM provider first.
summary.adminImpact: Remove existing MDM enrollment before directly enrolling Macs in Intune.

summary.headline: Apple JIT registration requirements reorganized
summary.summary: The JIT registration article restructures supported iOS/iPadOS enrollment scenarios and the compliance-policy requirement for JIT remediation.
summary.adminImpact: Assign compliance policies to devices if using JIT compliance remediation.

summary.headline: Company Portal Apple user enrollment support clarified
summary.summary: The guide identifies support for iOS 13+ and iPadOS 13.1+ and restructures setup requirements.
summary.adminImpact: Check device OS version before deploying Company Portal user enrollment.

summary.headline: Windows attestation platform requirements clarified
summary.summary: The attestation guide explicitly lists supported Windows 10 and Windows 11 build levels, TPM 2.0+, and physical-device-only support.
summary.adminImpact: Verify supported builds and TPM 2.0 before using attestation; do not expect virtual-device support.

summary.headline: Windows bulk-enrollment requirements reorganized
summary.summary: The bulk package guide moves Windows support and Microsoft Entra role requirements into a formal Requirements section.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm the operator has a supported unscoped Entra role before creating bulk enrollment tokens.

summary.headline: Windows backup requirements reorganized
summary.summary: The backup and restore guide structures requirements for Entra-joined or hybrid-joined devices and supported Windows builds.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm join state and documented Windows build requirements before enabling backup.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager 2603 hotfix article edited
summary.summary: The 2603 hotfix article received documentation edits without a substantive patch excerpt in the stored metadata.
summary.adminImpact: Review the current 2603 hotfix article when planning its installation.

summary.headline: School deployment tutorial link updated to bulk-package requirements
summary.summary: The education tutorial changes its bulk enrollment token reference from Roles and permissions to the renamed Requirements section.
summary.adminImpact: Use the Requirements section when checking permissions for bulk enrollment tokens.

summary.headline: Direct Android LOB feature is rolling out gradually
summary.summary: The What's New entry adds that the Direct Android LOB feature is gradually rolling out, with full availability expected by mid-May 2026.
summary.adminImpact: If unavailable, wait for rollout completion rather than treating it as a tenant configuration error.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager 2603 What's New received review edits
summary.summary: The 2603 What's New article received code-review documentation edits.
summary.adminImpact: No administrator action is identified in the stored patch evidence.

summary.headline: 2603 checklist language refined
summary.summary: The checklist changes early update ring wording from “opt-in” to “opt in” without changing the described process.
summary.adminImpact: No process change; continue using the early-ring opt-in procedure.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager 2603 hotfix guidance updated in review
summary.summary: The 2603 hotfix article received review edits to its version, checklist, prior-fix, and component-change content.
summary.adminImpact: Review the current hotfix page for the final installation and included-fix details.
